In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
resilience is a complex issue, which must be addressed at all levels of the production system and in relation to the patterns of events in order to be successful.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
resilience is a complex concept and that it is difficult to quantify and to compare.
resilience is a complex concept which must be considered in relation to the food safety of the entire production system and not just the individual farm.
to achieve resilience, focus must be put on the entire structure of production and not only on the event itself or on patterns of events.
The main takeaway from our work is that
resilience is not a property of a system, but rather a property of the relationship between the system and its environment.
the food safety system is not only a system of rules, but also a system of relationships between actors in the food chain.
a focus on the resilience of the entire production chain, including the consumer, is needed in order to ensure food safety.
